title: Baaxok ellecabo tatreh yan amoyti
intro: Caylale mirac ucsub, baaxol maqar kee reeda yomcowwe. Tama num qaadik yan safar abak, ayro elle cultah tan arac kee elle cultah tan arac gufteeh, qusba ummattat garayteeh, namma umaane le agattiinah addal kaxxa taqabi kataase. Tah cuumi le mirac miyyaay?
clues: Anu reeda yomcowweh sugeeh, ardik allal tan exxa gufaamih taagah.
Anu ayro korma fanah gexeeh, ayroytal cultam ubleh.
Anu ayroytak tawqe xaqut tan laqnak waaso sinni marat ongoorowe.
gersi ayyunti Gog kee Maagog deqsita namma umaadoobale agattiinah cato yok esserte.
Anu ken yabbixuh birta kee laqlaqinte nacasat xoqoysimak adaf xise.
Anu ta adaf yi Rabbik racmatta kinnim kee yibbixsime wakti fan raaqeleemih qaddoyse.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Goog kee Maagog qagitak adaf xisaanama
trial.answer: Goog kee Maagog qagitak adaf xisaanama

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Gog kee Maagog elle yibbixen uddur fanah suge
outcome.answer: Gog kee Maagog elle yibbixen uddur fanah suge

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
